title: llm-usage-metrics projects report output (v1)
description: Envelope and payload for projects --json output.

data.description: Per-project usage totals over the window, costliest first.

projects.description: Projects by cost, then tokens, then label; only the top N with --top (default 10, 0 for all).

granularity.description: With --granularity: the period of the periods rows.

periods.description: With --granularity: the listed projects' usage per period, by period, then label, unattributed usage last.

repoRoot.description: The project: the directory its session started in (trailing separators removed), or null for usage without one.

project.description: The project's display label, unique within the report.

totals.description: Totals over every project in the window, also those --top leaves out.

projects.description: Number of projects in the window, before --top.

events.description: Number of usage events in the window.

activeDays.description: Distinct local dates (report timezone) with usage.

projectRow.description: One project's usage over the window.

costShare.description: The project's part of the window's cost, from 0 to 1, rounded to 6 decimal places; null when the window has no positive cost or the project no resolved cost.

events.description: Number of usage events of the project.

activeDays.description: Distinct local dates (report timezone) with usage of the project.

topModels.description: The project's models with the most tokens, at most three.

modelBreakdown.description: Per-model usage totals inside a row.

periodProjectRow.description: One project's usage in one period.

periodKey.description: The period: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-Www or YYYY-MM in the report timezone.

models.description: The row's models, most tokens first.
